title: Markings
description: Pavement marking treatments for all four bikeway classes — bicycle lane lines and symbols, buffer-separated and physically separated bicycle lanes, intersection extensions and mixing zones, shared-lane markings, two-stage turn boxes, bicycle boxes, shared-use path markings, and green-colored pavement.
